verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a search platform, so it could plausibly version and roll back configurations such as settings or dynamic search rules, and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no versioning, review, change history, or rollback for automations or settings. MCP-driven settings changes and Dynamic Search Rules are adjacent features, not version control or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
